text:
Rhea D: Drafting a tight runbook 'Onboard Stress Test + Prefill/Batch/Stream Triage' — quick scan?
Marcus H: Love it. Can we keep AE heartbeat minimal: last_successful_stream, prefill_hit_rate_24h, avg_latency_ms?
Leah V: Add a renewal_risk flag + risk_reason enum (low/medium/high). AE handoffs want that.
Ian C: Also include 2 customer-facing curl tests and a reproduce checklist so AE can validate quickly.
Rhea D: I added header snippets for customers and AEs to paste:
```
X-Prefill: strategy=aggressive;ttl=450
X-Batch: mode=latency_first;max_wait_ms=40
X-Stream: prefill=2;keepalive=true
```
Marcus H: TTL guidance suggestion: use 1200 for low-volume chatty apps, 300 for heavy token pipelines. Call out tradeoffs.
Leah V: Telemetry event example to emit from SDK or proxy:
```
event: cs.stress_check
props: onboard_pct=0.5,last_successful_stream_ts=2034567000,failed_streams_48h=2,prefill_hits_24h=5,avg_latency_ms=210,net_sentiment=0.3
```
Ian C: Escalation rule proposal: failed_streams_48h >= 2 OR net_sentiment < 0.25 -> set renewal_risk=high, notify AE + CS Lead. Include outreach cadence and canned email.
Rhea D: Fallback play in runbook: when streaming degrades, switch to non-stream smaller model + aggressive batching, lower max_tokens, enable prefix cache. Tag account reduced_streaming=true.
Rhea D: Repro checklist for AE/customer:
- run curl stream test
- confirm runtime headers present
- check last_successful_stream timestamp in account record
- try non-stream fallback and capture response time
Ian C: Example curl (customer-facing):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Prefill: strategy=aggressive;ttl=450' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt":"stream test","stream":true}'
```
Marcus H: I'll wire the telemetry fields into the weekly AE dashboard and add a small alert for prefill_hit_rate < 0.2.
Leah V: I'll author short 7-day closed survey + 30-day freeform and map responses to net_sentiment & cited_issues.
Ian C: QA is good with the fallback steps. I'll prep two enablement slides for AE sync.
CS Bot: runbook-saved by Rhea D (link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/onboard-stress-203456)
Rhea D: Thanks team — will merge after Leah's survey templates and tag AE/ops. :thumbsup:
Marcus H: Approved from CS Ops side.
Leah V: No blockers, will drop templates by EOD.
